_comment: Fixed question set for the Archives retrieval-quality measurement (bin/measure_retrieval_quality.py). Each right answer was picked by reading the signal's own row in the live database read-only, never by running /signals/search. See the PR body for how each was chosen. kind is the embedded kind the question is meant to exercise; questions 1-5 are transcript-turn rows written by the operator, which library/decisions/0001 marks as what the index reduction risks losing.
